items.headline: Robinhood Markets and Albemarle have been highlighted as Zacks Bull and Bear of the Day
items.snippet: ALB earnings outlook dropped 13% for Q3 and 36% for Q4 since Q2 release; Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell). Lithium prices down ~80% from late-2022 highs.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus keeps Buy; lithium up ~67% YoY but below highs; supply/demand poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO keeps Outperform; lowers lithium targets after spot weakness, group viewed as oversold.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management: tight lithium market, demand +45% YoY through May, stationary storage ~30% of 2026 demand; 2026 outlook at high end of ranges.
